title: Hahnenkammbahn Kitzbühel
highlights: Ascent to the legendary Hahnenkamm high above Kitzbühel
Starting area of the world-famous Streif downhill race
Spectacular views over the Kitzbühel valley and mountain peaks
Theme trails and summer experiences for the entire family
kurzbeschreibung: The tradition-steeped Hahnenkammbahn leads up to the legendary Hahnenkamm, the starting point of the world-famous Streif race.
beschreibung:
In the Footsteps of Hahnenkamm Legends

The Hahnenkammbahn is a historic cable car that transports visitors straight from the centre of Kitzbühel up to the famous Hahnenkamm high plateau. This is the beating heart of alpine ski racing, where standing at the start of the notorious Streif lets you feel firsthand the fascination of the world's most demanding downhill course.

Hiking and Enjoyment on the Hahnenkamm

In summer, the racing slopes transform into a picturesque hiking area with panoramic views of Kitzbühel, the Wilder Kaiser, and the Brixental. Well-maintained panoramic trails, informative display boards detailing race history, and cosy mountain inns make a visit to the Hahnenkamm an unforgettable experience for sports enthusiasts and leisure seekers alike.
